findings.summary: billable_hours subtracts two aware datetimes sharing the same ZoneInfo tzinfo, which ignores the UTC offset, so sessions spanning a DST transition are over- or under-billed by an hour (fix: compute the duration in UTC).
Using ceil on a float could add a spurious billed hour for sub-second values on an exact hour boundary, though the reviewer considers it unlikely to matter.
invoice_lines calls billable_hours twice per session (directly and inside session_charge_cents), which is redundant but harmless.
